plugins.name: Audio description
plugins.description: Finds films and series in Jellyfin with a described sound track for blind and partially sighted people, and prefers releases with one in Reelix.
plugins.author: TheMightyTRexUK

plugins.name: Audio description tracks
plugins.description: Adds a description track you already have, such as one from AudioVault, to its film or episode in Jellyfin, after checking that the lengths match.
plugins.author: TheMightyTRexUK

plugins.name: Calibre-Web
plugins.description: Calibre-Web, a browser page for a Calibre library: read, search and send books to an e-reader. It reads your books folder and never changes it.
plugins.author: TheMightyTRexUK

plugins.name: Disk forecast
plugins.description: When each disk fills at the rate it has been filling over the last month.
plugins.author: TheMightyTRexUK

plugins.name: Ad blocking
plugins.description: How many adverts and trackers Pi-hole or AdGuard Home blocked today.
plugins.author: TheMightyTRexUK

plugins.name: Download summary
plugins.description: How much has downloaded today and this week, from what Starboard sees in the queue.
plugins.author: TheMightyTRexUK

plugins.name: Home Assistant
plugins.description: Your house in one sentence on the dashboard: the things you choose from Home Assistant.
plugins.author: TheMightyTRexUK

plugins.name: Jellystat
plugins.description: Jellystat, the full watch statistics app for Jellyfin, with its own PostgreSQL database, kept apart from the main install. Opens on its own web page.
plugins.author: TheMightyTRexUK

plugins.name: Kavita
plugins.description: Kavita, a reader for comics, manga and books in the browser and in e-reader apps (OPDS). It reads your books and comics folders and never changes them.
plugins.author: TheMightyTRexUK

plugins.name: Library health
plugins.description: Films and series in Jellyfin with no poster, no description or no year, so you can fix them.
plugins.author: TheMightyTRexUK

plugins.name: Line speed
plugins.description: Tests your internet download speed once a night, outside download hours, and keeps a week of results.
plugins.author: TheMightyTRexUK

plugins.name: Maintainerr
plugins.description: Maintainerr, clean-up rules for Jellyfin, such as films everyone has watched. It changes nothing until you give it keys and a rule that removes.
plugins.author: TheMightyTRexUK

plugins.name: Most watched
plugins.description: The films and series most people watched in Jellyfin in the last week.
plugins.author: TheMightyTRexUK

plugins.name: Navidrome
plugins.description: Navidrome, a music server for Subsonic apps on phones and in the car. It reads your music folder and never changes it.
plugins.author: TheMightyTRexUK

plugins.name: Notifications
plugins.description: Sends Starboard's events to email, Telegram, Discord, Signal, Pushover, ntfy or a webhook, in plain words, and a weekly New this week.
plugins.author: TheMightyTRexUK

plugins.name: Outside services
plugins.description: Up or down for things that are not on this server: your router, a NAS, a website.
plugins.author: TheMightyTRexUK

plugins.name: Remote access
plugins.description: Starboard, Jellyfin and Audiobookshelf away from home through Tailscale or Cloudflare Tunnel, with no port opened on your router.
plugins.author: TheMightyTRexUK

plugins.name: Seerr
plugins.description: Seerr, a requests page for Jellyfin users. Reelix already has requests in Starboard, so most people do not need it.
plugins.author: TheMightyTRexUK

plugins.name: Styles
plugins.description: Twenty-one accessible styles for Display: six reskin the whole look (cards, buttons, tabs, menus), checked for contrast.
plugins.author: TheMightyTRexUK

plugins.name: Tdarr
plugins.description: Tdarr converts films and series to save space, in Starboard's quiet hours. It can copy the Tdarr you already have, with its libraries and history.
plugins.author: TheMightyTRexUK

plugins.name: Uptime Kuma
plugins.description: Uptime Kuma, status checks for websites and services, with alerts and status pages. Starboard already watches your apps; this is for more.
plugins.author: TheMightyTRexUK

plugins.name: VPN check
plugins.description: Shows the address and country your downloads use through the VPN, and warns if it is your home address.
plugins.author: TheMightyTRexUK

plugins.name: Watch statistics
plugins.description: What was watched, by whom and when, and the top titles, from Jellyfin's Playback Reporting, with no second database.
plugins.author: TheMightyTRexUK

plugins.name: Watching now
plugins.description: Who is watching what in Jellyfin right now, with how far through they are.
plugins.author: TheMightyTRexUK

plugins.name: Wizarr
plugins.description: Wizarr, invitation links for Jellyfin: send someone a link and they make their own Jellyfin account, with the libraries you choose.
plugins.author: TheMightyTRexUK
